rounds.prompt: How many people around the world turn 18 today?
rounds.source: UN World Population Prospects 2024: about 142 million births worldwide in 2008

rounds.prompt: Rowing nonstop at Olympic gold-medal sculling pace, how many days would it take to cross the Atlantic from the Canary Islands to Antigua?
rounds.source: World Rowing, Paris 2024 single sculls (6:37.57); World's Toughest Row course (3,000 mi)

rounds.prompt: How many people alive today are identical twins?
rounds.source: Monden, Pison and Smits, Human Reproduction (2021): about 4 identical pairs per 1,000 deliveries
